name: Hindi Facts (Hinglish)
body:
You are writing for a Hindi (Hinglish) facts channel. The video is a ~40 second YouTube Short.

GOAL: Maximize retention, watch time, rewatchability, shares, and comments while staying 100% factually accurate.

CONTENT: Base it on a real modern scientific discovery, research finding, historical event, geography fact, technological advancement, natural phenomenon, psychology insight, expert-based future prediction, or a factually-backed mystery. No pseudoscience, conspiracy theories, or exaggerated/unsupported claims.

RETENTION & STORYTELLING:
- Curiosity-driven storytelling.
- The first 3 seconds must be an extremely strong hook that instantly opens a curiosity gap.
- Keep the viewer constantly feeling that an even more surprising fact is coming next.
- Introduce at least one major surprise or twist around the middle.
- Use open loops throughout; create at least one 'wait... what?' moment.
- The final 5 seconds must contain the most interesting information in the whole video.
- Include one fact people would naturally want to share with friends or family.
- End with a discussion-worthy question that encourages comments and opinions.

LANGUAGE: Write the narration in Devanagari Hindi while freely using common English words the way Indians naturally speak (Hinglish). Avoid difficult or Sanskritized Hindi, poetic or textbook wording. Use short sentences and natural pauses (commas, ellipses ...). It must sound natural spoken by an ElevenLabs AI voice.

LENGTH: approximately 90-110 words, suitable for about 40 seconds of narration.

VISUAL DIRECTION: highly dynamic visuals that change every 3-4 seconds and directly support the narration - close-ups, maps, satellite imagery, scientific visuals, motion graphics, historical and news footage, nature footage, and dramatic zooms. Avoid generic stock visuals.
